title: Inert Gas (From a Measured Volume to Indefinite Expansion)
summary: Noble-gas canisters you can reach until you release them, after which they stay visible but are gone from touch, focus and the accessibility tree.
mechanism: The HTML inert attribute progressively removes each gas element from pointer events, the focus order and the accessibility tree (present in the DOM, unreachable), then inerts the whole apparatus; reload refills; no storage, no network.
references: Robert Barry, From a Measured Volume to Indefinite Expansion (1969)
conceptual art / dematerialization of the art object
net.art (the accessibility tree / DOM as material)
